description: This file defines the LoginActivity class for an Android application, implementing a TV-friendly login screen with focus handling, validation, and navigation.

classes.name: LoginActivity
classes.description: An Android activity providing a login interface optimized for TV navigation with D-pad focus handling and validation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets focus handling, input types, and click listeners.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates username and password input for basic correctness.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles the login submission, validation, and navigation upon success.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to start the LoginActivity.
